description: Golden set for statute retrieval. Each query is a legal question; `expected` lists the citation(s) that should be retrieved. A query is a hit if any expected citation appears in the top-k. Queries are labelled by whether they reward semantic (paraphrase) or lexical (exact-term) retrieval, so the two halves of the hybrid retriever can be judged separately.
